mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transaction (wallet_id, transaction_type, parent_transaction_id, amount, status, remark, failure_reason, completed_at) VALUES (#{walletId}, #{transactionType}, #{parentTransactionId}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{failureReason}, #{completedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM transaction WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} AND transaction_type = 'CHARGE' AND status IN ('CREATED','WITHDRAWING','WITHDRAWN','DEPOSITING','UNKNOWN','COMPENSATING')

SELECT t.id, t.wallet_id, t.transaction_type, t.parent_transaction_id, t.amount, t.status, t.remark, t.failure_reason, t.created_at, t.completed_at FROM transaction t JOIN wallet w ON t.wallet_id = w.id WHERE t.id = #{id} AND w.user_id = #{userId} AND t.transaction_type = 'CHARGE'
